name_zh: 惊跳眨眼反射幅度（情绪调制）
reason: The primary dependent measure of affect-modulated startle is the eyeblink recorded from orbicularis oculi EMG (Vrana et al. 1988, doi:10.1037/0021-843x.97.4.487; guidelines Blumenthal et al. 2005, doi:10.1111/j.1469-8986.2005.00271.x). No registry marker covers it; EMO-STARTLE-001 temporarily uses MK.P3a for the probe P3 (Schupp et al. 1997, doi:10.1111/j.1469-8986.1997.tb02409.x). Maintainer to decide whether a peripheral reflex marker is admissible in knowledge/markers/ (curator_e, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).
